subject.title: Feature request: Shareable cron job templates

question: Should ClawHub support shareable scheduled-job templates, and if so should they be modeled as a new package family, a skill/category convention, a bundle-plugin pattern, or an OpenClaw runtime/plugin feature?
rationale: Current main has only adjacent skills/plugins/category surfaces, while one-click scheduled-job installation changes product scope and security boundaries that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Design First
options.body: Keep the issue open and require a maintainer-authored product/security design before any implementation PR changes schema or install semantics.

options.title: Constrain To Existing Skills
options.body: Treat cron examples as ordinary Automation skills for now, with no separate cron-template catalog or one-click scheduled-job install surface.

options.title: Close As Out Of Scope
options.body: Decline a dedicated cron-template surface unless OpenClaw core first defines a supported scheduled-job import contract.

recommendation.title: Design First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require a maintainer-authored product/security design before any implementation PR changes schema or install semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The current package catalog plan, category taxonomy, and OpenClaw scope guardrails in local history are attributed to Patrick-Erichsen.
